tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.hint: Tasks are created in the conversation with the agent: ask it to remind you once or to do something regularly.
tasks.example: “Every Monday at 10:00 send me a metrics summary in Telegram”
tasks.emptyHint: Ask your agent in the chat to create one.
tasks.cancelText: The task «{title}» will not run any more.
tasks.channelUnavailable: channel unavailable, delivered to the web

memory.title: Memory
memory.lead: What your agent remembers about you. It saves facts in conversations; you can edit, delete or add records.
memory.clearText: All records will be deleted. The agent will stop using them from the next message.
memory.emptyHint: Tell the agent what to remember, or add a record.

space.title: Space
space.lead: The personal workspace of your agent: files persist between conversations and are isolated from other users.
space.emptyHint: Files the agent creates and files you upload appear here.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lead: Messengers for talking to your agent and the tools of the company it may use.
connections.tokenHint: The token is stored encrypted in Nabu, never in the agent's space.
connections.channelUnavailable: The channel is not available for your account.
connections.keyHint: Get a personal key and send it to the bot {bot} once.
connections.keyText: Send this key to {bot} as the first message.
connections.keyOnce: Copy the key now: it is shown only once. To see a key again, reissue it.
connections.emailHint: Write to the bot from your corporate address. The bot answers by mail only when it is the only recipient; otherwise the answer waits in Nabu.
connections.vkteamsHint: Add the bot to your contacts or write to it first: it finds you by the email of your account.

admin.title: Administration
admin.noAccess: The platform administrator role is required

users.title: Users
users.inviteHint: The user gets the role at the first sign-in.
users.newIdentity: A new ID at the sign-in provider: {subject}. Restoring links it to the archived account.
users.sameIdentity: The same ID at the sign-in provider.
users.archiveHint: Sign-in and all channels are closed, tasks are paused, the sandbox, personal accesses and the Telegram link are removed. Conversations, memory and files are kept until the retention ends.

models.title: Model connections
models.lead: Direct connections to providers or to an OpenAI-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM.
models.name: Name
models.personalHint: The default model of personal agents and the models users may choose.

harness.title: Harness
harness.lead: Environments agents run in. This release has Pi.
harness.name: Harness

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.name: Name

modeHint.personal: Users grant access on their own behalf; the agent acts with their rights.
modeHint.platform: A service credential of the platform; read-only unless switched off.

catalog.delegationHint: Nabu signs a token for this audience and passes the user's email; the product checks the signature by Nabu's keys.

service-agents.title: Service agents
service-agents.lead: Preconfigured executors of background tasks that services call through the API.
service-agents.name: Name
service-agents.mcpHint: Platform MCP servers only; callers can pass their own servers for one run.
service-agents.callerMcp: Accept MCP servers of the caller

clients.title: Service clients
clients.auditHint: Actions on behalf of users are written to the audit with the client.
clients.secretOnce: Copy the secret now: it is shown only once.
clients.name: Name

channels.title: Channels
channels.lead: Where users talk to their agents and who has access to each channel.
channels.domainsHint: Letters are accepted only from these domains.
channels.authservHint: The server name in the Authentication-Results header of the provider; filled by the provider.
channels.secretSet: Set. Enter a new value to replace it
channels.secretHint: The secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
channels.rules: The bot answers by mail only when it is the only recipient: one address in To and an empty Cc. Other letters are answered in the topic of the web application. Actions that change data wait for the confirmation of the user.

group-agents.title: Group agents
group-agents.lead: Agents of group chats with their own memory and space and platform access only.
group-agents.transferHint: The new owner is an administrator or a member of the group with access to the channel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.retentionHint: After this time an archived account and its data are deleted for good. The same time is kept for the data of a group agent removed from its group.
settings.confirmText: The new retention of {days} days applies to all archived accounts.
settings.willPurge: {count, plural, =0 {No account is deleted by the next purge.} one {The next purge deletes # account.} other {The next purge deletes # accounts.}}

agent-pods.title: Agents
agent-pods.lead: Every user and every group agent runs in a pod of its own. A stopped pod loses nothing: the conversation continues from the last answer.
agent-pods.local: Agents run in the shared operator: pods of owners are off in this installation.
agent-pods.emptyHint: A pod starts with the first message of a user.
agent-pods.stopText: The agent is answering the user now. The turn will be interrupted: the user will see an error and can send the message again. The conversation stays.
agent-pods.fullQueue: {count, plural, one {# message waits} other {# messages wait}} in the queue, the oldest for {time}.

fullSources.config: The ceiling of {max} pods comes from the settings (AGENT_PODS_MAX).
fullSources.quota: The ceiling of {max} pods comes from the quota of the namespace.
fullSources.cluster: The ceiling of {max} pods comes from the cluster: a new pod could not be placed at {when}.

agent-pods.fullAdvice: To serve more users, add nodes or lower the resource requests of a pod.
